wavefunctions.name: Wavefunctions: What Returns
wavefunctions.truth: Returning to one value need not mean returning to the same state. Follow what a repeated movement carries into a record, a space, a sound and a sum.
wavefunctions.qfep_connection: The sequence asks which differences a returning pattern carries or hides, and which authored boundaries and receivers make that return possible. Periodicity, coupling and chance are distinct operations to investigate.
wavefunctions.formula: x(t) = A sin(ωt + φ); y(t) = Σₙ₌₁⁵ aₙ sin(nωt)
wavefunctions.demonstration: Release a pendulum, compare sampling clocks, walk beside sine-shaped space, then discover the coordinate projection of a turning point. Compare coupling, modulation, chance, struck voices, sampled steps, beats and finite harmonic sums.
wavefunctions.description: What returns changes with the state we retain and the body that receives it. Motion becomes a record, periodic coordinates become space, and simple sources meet as sound or a visible sum. The sequence preserves the difference between a mathematical rule and what a visitor can do with its implementation.
learning_objectives: Distinguish a returning position from a returning state using velocity and release conditions
Compare sampling intervals, retained duration and stroboscopic records on a finite clock
Compare sine-shaped collision terrain with moving visual boundaries
Predict sine and cosine as coordinate projections of angular progression
Compare driven local motion with motion transmitted through neighbour coupling
Hear phase modulation while holding a reference and separating envelope, index and frequency ratio
Distinguish periodic form through height, whole-object rotation and sampled walking affordances
Distinguish chance event ordering from the prepared vocabulary it selects
Compare a struck voice, a restrike and the sampled sum of independent voices
Read a beat envelope without confusing the sum with either input
Build finite sums of five nonnegative, phase-locked harmonics and inspect the limits of their recipe labels
